notes:
## Fixed

- Preserve original window geometry when an animated Accessibility write is cancelled and its rollback cannot read the frame. Also retain completed writes delivered during permission freeze, while preserving manual geometry, process-generation checks and native-call draining.
- Keep independent minimized or hidden windows with matching frames separate when an Accessibility inventory temporarily omits one of them. Require known tab membership before replacing a tab seat.
- Confirm helper-window activation with the system-wide native focus before allowing minimize-on-toggle. Clear stale active highlighting when ProperWM or an excluded application becomes frontmost.
- Stop Finder fast and fallback capture attempts after the original action is cancelled, while allowing an already admitted native call to drain.

## Performance and cleanup

- Move initial icon metadata stamp reads off the main thread onto the existing utility queue. Coalesce checks, initialize missing stamps once, ignore stale cache generations and avoid rereading initialized icons for every new icon.
- Remove unused minimize and single-window reorder entry points, unreachable projection diagnostics, redundant topology storage and an unused global-focus timestamp. Supported toggle, group ordering and local-focus freshness checks remain covered.
- No new runtime dependencies, periodic timers or input observation.

## Verification

All 991 XCTest tests pass locally, with an additional 209-test constrained-executor run, 13 Python tests, 24 Node.js tests and 3 WindowLab checks. Independent repeat review has no open findings. The completion/freeze regression uses a deterministic boundary and is verified with mutation RED/GREEN.

The release workflow reruns tests, constrained-executor lifecycle checks, WindowLab replay, deployment checks and Apple Silicon package verification before publication. Live CPU and RAM usage were not profiled.
